source_title: Duration: 2:59 US Jobless Claims Fall as Philadelphia Fed Index Rises
speaker: Bloomberg
speaker_context: Duration: 2:59 US Jobless Claims Fall as Philadelphia Fed Index Rises

clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 美国失业金申领人数下降 费城联储指数回升
title_lines: 美国失业金申领人数下降
劳动力市场稳定但通胀压力仍在

subtitles.en: Well, what I see is Kevin Warsh gets a break. He doesn't have to worry about the labor market.
subtitles.zh: 凯文·沃什可以松口气了，他不必担心劳动力市场。

subtitles.en: He didn't talk much about it yesterday. It does seem to be stable.
subtitles.zh: 他昨天没怎么提这个，市场似乎很稳定。

subtitles.en: 226,000 initial jobless claims, and that's a decline from 230,000, which is revised up from 229 last week.
subtitles.zh: 首次申请失业救济人数22.6万，低于上周修正后的23万。
zh_highlights: 首次申请失业救济人数

subtitles.en: Either way, you look at it. It shows jobless claims relatively stable.
subtitles.zh: 无论怎么看，失业救济申请都相对稳定。

subtitles.en: They've moved up over the last couple of weeks, but not significantly the country is still maybe not hiring a few more people they are,
subtitles.zh: 过去几周略有上升，但幅度不大，企业招聘可能没有大幅增加。

subtitles.en: but maybe not hiring in big numbers, but they're certainly not firing at this point.
subtitles.zh: 但至少目前没有大规模裁员。

subtitles.en: Continuing claims, 1,800 and 10,000 do rise from 1,786,000.
subtitles.zh: 持续申请失业救济人数从178.6万升至181万。
zh_highlights: 持续申请失业救济人数

subtitles.en: So maybe some people are having a little harder time getting a job, but these are weekly numbers, so they do bounce around a lot.
subtitles.zh: 可能有些人找工作更难了，但周度数据波动较大。

subtitles.en: But the bottom line is it's not a major big deal.
subtitles.zh: 总体来看，这不是什么大问题。

subtitles.en: The Philadelphia Fed numbers are out as well, and the Philadelphia Fed index rises to 10.3 from negative 0.4.
The prices paid index is at 53.2 versus 47.9.
subtitles.zh: 支付价格指数为53.2，而前值为47.9。

subtitles.en: So we still have inflation. That's no surprise given that we saw prices rise significantly during this war.
subtitles.zh: 所以通胀依然存在。考虑到战争期间价格大幅上涨，这并不意外。

subtitles.en: We don't know how much or how often they're going to go down, but it does show business a little bit stronger in the Philadelphia area.
subtitles.zh: 我们不知道价格会下降多少或多久，但这确实表明费城地区商业活动略有增强。
